Note: FP16 sparse: 36 bits/group (2x16 values + 4 metadata). Also provides 2x Tensor Core compute speedup.
2-bit sparse: 8 bits/group (2x2 + 4 meta). Same as pure 2-bit quant (32.02 MB): metadata cancels sparsity savings. Sparsity value is compute, not storage.
ANS lossless via nvCOMP: 80% of input retained (20% compressed away). Decoded on CUDA cores at ~200 GB/s. NOT NVDEC.
